name: Luminous Gearwork Conservatory
description: A conservatory where giant clockwork gears support glass panes, each gear turning to track the sun and flood the space with patterned light.
prompt: Interior of a grand conservatory: massive brass gears integrated into the framework, slowly rotating. Glass walls and roof. Sunlight creates shifting geometric patterns on lush tropical plants. Detailed steampunk‑botanical fusion, 8k.
caption: Time turns, light dances. ⚙️🌿 #LuminousGearworkConservatory
